Hi Jordan / Priya —

Great to meet this morning. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Goal: Replace legacy on-prem inference endpoints for customer-facing chat with a single, lower-latency hosted endpoint while keeping PII isolated.
- Peak concurrency: ~80 live sessions, median prompt length ~120 tokens, occasional bursts during campaigns.
- Key constraints: SOC 2 evidence, VPC peering for data path, predictable monthly committed capacity.

I attached the pricing deck we discussed (redwood-pricing-deck-v1.pdf) — pages 6-8 include the Dedicated vs Hosted comparison and cost estimates for the baseline traffic you described.

Suggested next steps:
1) You review the deck with the infra/ops team.
2) I can set up a 30-min walkthrough next week to go through the cost model and the deployment options.
3) If you want a formal SOW, I can route it to legal; estimate will be based on the committed capacity in the deck.

Questions I had after the call: are multi-region active-active failover and retention windows (~30/90/365 days) priorities for Q3? That will change the Dedicated sizing.

I copied Rishi (SE) for any architecture questions and Dylan (my manager) for visibility.

Thanks — I’ll check back mid-next-week.

Best,
